surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 21 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Lail (The Night) is the 92th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 21 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والليل اذا يغشى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the night when it covers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the enshrouding night

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the day when it appears
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the radiant day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] He who created the male and female
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by His creation of male and female

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, your efforts are diverse
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The ways you take differ greatly

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As for he who gives and fears Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And believes in the best [reward]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who testifies to goodness––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We will ease him toward ease
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall smooth his way towards ease

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And denies the best [reward]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who denies goodness––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We will ease him toward difficulty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall smooth his way towards hardship

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما يغني عنه ماله اذا تردى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and his wealth will not help him as he falls

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Our part is to provide guidance––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this world and the next belong to Us––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so I warn you about the raging Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in which none but the most wicked one will burn

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who had denied and turned away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who denied [the truth], and turned away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But the righteous one will avoid it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The most pious one will be spared this––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who gives his wealth away as self-purification

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةࣲ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما لاحد عنده من نعمة تجزى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: not to return a favour to anyone

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he is going to be satisfied
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and he will be well pleased
